messages:
Maria Cho: Heads-up — prepping for a customer security call (Acquia Health) tomorrow. They're asking for details on audit granularity, KMS event shipping, ephemeral service accounts for Private deployments, and they've flagged a CVE in our on‑prem image. Need short answers + owners. Can people help? cc @Raj Patel @Kim Lee

Raj Patel: I can take 1 & 2. Short answers to use in the questionnaire: we log request metadata: timestamp, tenant_id, route, model_version, caller_ip, api_key_id, and key_id when KMS ops occur. Default retention is 90d for hosted; enterprise customers can request up to 365d and we provide exportable log bundles. Logs are tamper-evident (signatures/log chaining) for attestation. For SIEM ingest we support:
- syslog/forwarder to customer endpoint
- S3 export + Kinesis for streaming ingestion
- direct agent integration (Datadog Agent, Splunk HEC)

Raj Patel: Sample audit query (redact before sharing):
```
index="redwood-audit" tenant_id="acct-123" | fields @timestamp, event_type, actor, key_id, model_version, caller_ip | sort @timestamp desc | limit 100
```

Kim Lee: I'll own the questionnaire text and the preflight doc. For ephemeral service accounts: we issue short-lived tokens via our STS layer and recommend connecting Private deployments to the customer's IdP for ephemeral SA provisioning (SCIM + short TTL). Minimal example RBAC policy to give the customer for docs (redacted):
```json
{
  "role": "inference.executor",
  "scopes": ["model:invoke"],
  "ttl": "1h"
}
```

Alex Green: On the libssl CVE — which image tag did they flag? If it's a Private/onprem image we can rebuild with patched OpenSSL and push a hotfix image, run regression suite. If it's critical we do a hotpatch; otherwise schedule in the next weekly image roll. Let's triage in #vuln-triage in 30m.

Maria Cho: Image tag they listed: `private/runtime:2026-03-10`. CVE they referenced: CVE-2026-1478 (customer concerned about remote exploit). They want ETA and mitigations to communicate.

Raj Patel: I'll prepare a redacted log sample and checklist for the customer pack: confirm KMS audit exports, key rotation state, and proof of exporter config. Example export command (internal):
```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit-exports/tenant-123/2026-03-09.json - | jq '.[] | {ts, tenant_id, event, key_id, actor}'
```

sre-bot: Created ticket INF-2026-987 (onprem-openssl-patch). Assigned to @Alex Green. ETA 48h.

Alex Green: Acknowledged. I'll run `make images && ci/run-regressions.sh` and aim to have a PR today. If CI shows regressions we'll fallback to mitigation (restrict external admin, firewall rules).

Kim Lee: :thumbsup: I'll draft the questionnaire answers and attach the redacted log sample + RBAC snippet. Ping me for review before EOD.

Maria Cho: Thanks — plan: Raj drop the redacted sample into the preflight pack, Kim finalizes questionnaire sections Q1-Q6, Alex updates INF-2026-987 with the PR link. We'll present this on the call at 15:00 PT tomorrow.
